# UnjamKit

> Free, single-purpose browser tools for everyday office tasks. Files are processed on the user's own device in the browser tab and are not uploaded. No account or subscription.

Each tool page states its limits (formats, sizes, what it does not do). Visit statistics use Google Analytics; tool content is never sent. Source code: https://github.com/yaoyc2004/unjamkit.com

## Tools

- [Image Fit](https://unjamkit.com/image-fit/): compress a JPG, PNG, WebP or PDF to a maximum file size in KB (for example 200 KB or 100 KB). Images become JPG; PDFs stay PDF with pages re-rendered as images at a chosen DPI.
- [HEIC Convert](https://unjamkit.com/heic-to-jpg/): convert iPhone HEIC/HEIF photos to JPG, or combine up to 50 photos into one PDF.
- [CSV to Excel](https://unjamkit.com/csv-to-excel/): convert a CSV to an XLSX with every cell stored as text, so leading zeros and long IDs are kept; the workbook is checked against the CSV before download.
- [PPT Notes Compare](https://unjamkit.com/ppt-notes/): compare speaker notes between two versions of a PowerPoint .pptx (slides paired by content), export a recording checklist, or extract all notes from one deck.
- [Batch Rename](https://unjamkit.com/batch-rename/): rename up to 200 files at once with a prefix, find and replace and numbering, or from a two-column old-name/new-name list pasted from Excel; duplicate and invalid names are blocked; download renamed copies as a ZIP with a CSV list of the changes.
- [PDF Stack](https://unjamkit.com/pdf-stack/): merge PDFs, reorder, rotate and extract pages.
- [Clean Copy](https://unjamkit.com/clean-copy/): remove unwanted line breaks from text copied out of a PDF while keeping paragraphs.
- [List Match](https://unjamkit.com/list-match/): compare two lists to find shared items and items missing from either list.
- [JustMakeQR](https://justmakeqr.com/): static QR code generator. [Wi-Fi QR code](https://justmakeqr.com/wifi-qr-code/) for guest networks.
